device.title: Device
device.subtitle: Plug a device in over USB and its identity and readiness show up here automatically.
device.identifiedAs: Identified as an {platform} device. Everything below was read without modifying the device.
device.maskedNote: UDID, ECID and serial are partially masked. Full values never appear in the UI or the log.

empty.title: Waiting for a device
empty.body: Pocket Studio identifies connected USB devices and checks readiness. This is a UI demo; use the button below to simulate a connection.
empty.step1: Connect the device to this computer with a reliable cable.
empty.step2: Unlock the device and keep it connected for pairing.
empty.step3: Keep the device unlocked on the home screen. Identification usually takes a few seconds.

next.title: The device is ready for Pocket
next.body: You can now install the Pocket runtime and compatible software from the App Store.
